RagShortTexts: The Husn Fulq camel is a prized riding camel domesticated by Aserai merchants.

Variants.Content: The Husn Fulq camel is a prized breed of riding camel domesticated by Aserai merchants. Standing a man and a half tall, it can trample any infantryman underfoot and gives its rider an unmatched sense of security. Among the Aserai, only nobles and the Sultan ride such prime camels. A noble mounted on a camel looks towering and imposing, effectively intimidating the enemy. Moreover, the Husn camel runs very fast—almost no different from a fine steed—so riding one never feels clumsy or sluggish.
